title: Serpentine Staffs - Reblocked
description: Adds staffs that may or may not be from a certain franchise to the game!
body:
Installing this allows you to obtain custom modelled serpentine staffs by renaming spears of (almost) any rarity to one of the following handles:

- Anacondrai Staff             (Purple Core, Golden Staff)
- Fangpyre Staff               (Red Core, Golden Staff)
- Venomari Staff               (Green Core, Golden Staff)
- Constrictai Staff            (Orange Core, Golden Staff)
- Hypnobrai Staff              (Blue Core, Golden Staff)
- Remnant Staff                (No Core, Green Staff, Red Eyes)

I tested the resource pack thoroughly, nevertheless I am but one person. Feel free to point out any bugs or incompatibilities!
